Runs continuously to process in workflows activities/actions in progress.
Job to send any future communications or communications not sent immediately by Rock.
Attempts to standardize and geocode addresses that have not been verified yet. It also attempts to re-verify address that failed in the past after a given wait period.
Executes a stored procedure that detects potential duplicate person records and stores the results.

Calculates and sends any following event notices to those that are following the entities that have an event that occurred.
Calculates and sends any following suggestions to those people that are eligible for following.

This job sends payment reminders to registration contacts with an active balance. For the reminder to be sent the registration template must have a 'Payment Reminder Time Span' configured. Also emails will not be sent to registrations where the instance close date is past the job's 'Cut-off Date' setting.
Job that populates Rock's family analytics
Downloads any payments that have been processed for the active scheduled transactions.
Fetches Rock notifications from the Spark Development Network
Checks scheduled transactions for credit cards that are expiring next month and sends an email notice to the person.
Performs routine SQL Server database maintenance.
Re-indexes the selected entity types in Universal Search.
Sends an email to a list of recipients when there are communications that have been queued to send for longer than a specified time period.
Job to take care of schema changes ( dynamic Attribute Value Fields ) and data updates to the BI related analytic tables
Re-calculates all person signals to ensure that the top-most signal is still the current one.
Job to makes sure that persisted dataviews are updated based on their schedule interval.
Updates person/family information based on data automation settings.
Creates Historical snapshots of Groups and Group Members for any group types that have history enabled.

Charge future transactions where the FutureProcessingDateTime is now or has passed.
Sends Group Scheduling Confirmation and Reminder emails to people that haven't been notified yet.
Sends reminders to persons with pending assessments if the created date/time is less than the calculated cut off date and the last reminder date is greater than the calculated reminder date.
Creates steps for people within a dataview

This job will collect a few hosting metrics regarding the usage of resources such as the database connection pool. Note that this Job can be activated/deactivated by navigating to "Admin Tools > System Settings > System Configuration > Web.Config Settings" and toggling the "Enable Database Performance Counters" setting.
Handles processing all configured campaigns, creating new connection requests and assigning them to connectors as needed.
Runs data updates that need to occur after a new installation.
This job will take care of any data migrations that need to occur after a new installation. After all the operations are done, this job will delete itself.
Synchronizes media content from configured Media Accounts.
Job that updates giving classifications and journey stages, and send any giving alerts.
This job will perform routine operations on active connection requests. This includes processing any configured Status Automation rules that are configured on the Connection Type.
Updates the person account protection profiles.
A job that updates the content collections search index.
A job which processes reminders, including creating appropriate notifications and updating the reminder count value for people with active reminders.

Sends a reminder to group leaders about entering attendance for their group meeting.  This job is meant to run many times per day and will only send reminders to groups when the configured time has passed.  By default, this job runs every 15 minutes, and it will send reminders to any group whose time threshold has passed since the last time it ran.
Send any sign-up reminders that are due to be sent.
Job to update the AnalyticsSourcePostalCode table with geographical and census data.
This job will update persisted datasets.

This job will send any unsent class announcements as well as an available activity digest emails for all their newly available activities within a learning program. The class announcements SystemCommunication is configured by the job setting and contains the Person and Announcement merge fields. The Available Activity Notification is configured by the learning program and contains ActivityCount and Courses (a list of CourseInfo) merge fields.
A job that updates learning program completion records for programs that track completion status.
Job that calculates Rock's peer networks for individuals.
Job that performs synchronization tasks between Rock and the external chat system.
This job processes Communication Flows creating new communications as needed and tracks conversions for flows that have goals.
Job that updates Step Program Completion Data.
Job that update the usage information of Media Elements by other entities.
Updates touchpoints for people using the outreach toolbox and sends any required notifications.
Rock Update Helper v17.10 - Fix Transaction Image Mime Types
This job will set the mime type of check images uploaded by the Check Scanner to image/png so that they can be displayed.
Rock Update Helper v17.11 - Clean Social Media Account Values
This job will clean up Social Media Account attribute values that are not safe to display.
Rock Update Helper v17.11 - Fix Person Image Mime Types
This job will set the mime type of person photos uploaded from mobile devices so that they can be displayed.
This job will perform operations on the InteractionSession data and, if enabled, Geocode new InteractionSessionLocation records or link existing records to InteractionSession records.
